g.text: 1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm AND DEGREES. EVERY
DIMENSION AND EVERY HOLE CALLOUT WAS MEASURED
2. THINNEST WALL, WHOLE SOLID: 1.3500 mm, AT
X=0.737 Y=-7.361 Z=1.000 — MEASURED OVER THE
WHOLE SOLID BY RAY+EXACT AT 0.669 mm SAMPLE
SPACING (A FEATURE NARROWER THAN THAT CAN BE
MISSED). A RAY MINIMUM AT AN EDGE, A FILLET
RUN-OUT OR A CHAMFER TIP IS A REAL DISTANCE
THROUGH MATERIAL AND IS NOT A PRINTABLE WALL.
3. GENERAL TOLERANCE: CANNOT DETERMINE — THIS PART
DECLARES NO PROCESS THIS REPO CAN READ.
4. SECTION A-A AT X=0.00: THINNEST MATERIAL IN
THIS PLANE ONLY 1.35 mm, AT Y=-6.72, Z=0.18 — A
SCAN OF ONE CUT, NOT THE PART MINIMUM.
